description: Read reported current navigation state and stack. includeSitemap:true includes available configured route paths; it does not establish complete application route coverage. Use get_events with sources:["route"] for retained navigation history.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

includeSitemap.description: Also list available configured route paths (can be long). Default false.

name: get_routes
